definitionEn: The technical safety requirements and their allocation to system elements.

example.en: How does the technical safety concept implement the functional safety requirements?
example.ko: 기술 안전 컨셉은 기능 안전 요구사항을 어떻게 구현합니까?

definitionEn: A technical solution that detects, controls or mitigates faults to keep or reach a safe state.

example.en: Which safety mechanism detects this failure mode?
example.ko: 어떤 안전 메커니즘이 이 고장 모드를 검출합니까?

collocations: diagnostic coverage of the safety mechanism

definitionEn: The structure of a system, its elements and their interfaces.

example.en: Where are the safety mechanisms shown in the system architecture?
example.ko: 시스템 아키텍처에서 안전 메커니즘은 어디에 표시되어 있습니까?

pitfall: ch는 /k/ 소리, 강세는 첫 음절 AR. 형용사 architectural은 ar-chi-TEC-tur-al.

definitionEn: Having more than one means to perform a function so that one can take over if another fails.

example.en: Is the redundancy independent enough to avoid common cause failures?
example.ko: 이중화가 공통 원인 고장을 피할 만큼 충분히 독립적입니까?

definitionEn: A check whether a signal value is realistic compared to other signals or limits.

example.en: The wheel speed signals are monitored by a plausibility check.
example.ko: 휠 속도 신호는 타당성 검사로 감시됩니다.

definitionEn: Deliberately introducing faults to check that safety mechanisms react correctly.

example.en: Were the safety mechanisms verified by fault injection tests?
example.ko: 안전 메커니즘을 고장 주입 시험으로 검증했습니까?

definitionEn: Checking by review, analysis or test that a work product meets its requirements.

example.en: What verification methods did you use for this requirement?
example.ko: 이 요구사항에 어떤 검증 방법을 사용했습니까?

definitionEn: Confirming at vehicle level that the safety goals are achieved.

example.en: How is safety validation planned at vehicle level?
example.ko: 차량 수준의 안전 타당성 확인은 어떻게 계획되어 있습니까?

definitionEn: The conditions that decide whether a test passes or fails.

example.en: The pass/fail criteria are not defined for these test cases.
example.ko: 이 시험 케이스들에는 합격/불합격 기준이 정의되어 있지 않습니다.
